title: Ice Fishing Experience in Anchorage
includes: All gear and tackle are included as well as food and drinks, everything but a fishing license.
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Must be able to walk short distances on uneven terrain
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We are a guide owned & operated company, we live in AK. year round and love showing people our state! We love to fish but enjoy providing people with an incredible experience that is more than just chasing fish. From our hot homemade lunch to the companionship of our dogs on the trips adds to the already incredible fishing and wild places that AK. has to offer our guests. On your day on the ice with us you will learn how to ice fish in Alaska, you may see some moose or bald eagles and hear many a fishing tale from our seasoned and experienced guides.
